goal: Ensure nodes maintain enough outbound peers that relay transactions
Prevents peers that decline transaction relay from silently degrading propagation topology
agreement: Early positive sentiment with no open objections

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because outbound full-relay slots can be silently consumed by peers that decline transaction relay
Preserves transaction broadcast and network propagation topology without requiring operator intervention
Addresses longstanding issues where nodes are left with too few peers for transaction relay
